part.text: The red ball is now straight ahead, slightly to the left and far off. I'll walk most of the way toward it, then check the distance.

state.title: naoqi_go

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The walk stopped early because of an object close on my left. The ball is still ahead, slightly to my right. I'll step forward a metre to the right of the obstacle.

state.title: naoqi_go

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The ball is now almost dead ahead and lower in the frame, so it's getting closer. I'll take a short forward step.

state.title: naoqi_walk_to

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The ball is close now and slightly to my left. Collision protection has stopped me twice, so I'll take a small step forward.

state.title: naoqi_walk_to

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The ball is now just ahead of the robot, close to its feet and slightly to the left. That's close enough, so I'll stop here.

state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: The robot is resting, but this view shows the ball farther away than I judged. I stopped too early, so I'll stand back up and keep going.

state.title: naoqi_stand

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text: I'm standing again, and the ball is still ahead and a bit farther than I'd like. I'll walk forward about 0.6 m and check the view.
